name: Turin primary teacher exploring employed education roles

context.seniority: Experienced teacher; new to adjacent occupations
constraints: Employed work rather than self-employed coaching
Private schools, educational publishing or learning coordination
context.company_awareness: Knows schools and some publishers but not their role vocabulary

trigger: The teacher wants to use curriculum and learning-design experience outside the current classroom role and starts comparing nearby employers.

searches_run.query: lavoro insegnante scuola primaria privata Torino
searches_run.observation: Retrieval mixed private-school pages, language teaching, classroom support and job boards. Some results concerned different age groups or internships rather than an experienced primary-school role.

searches_run.query: lavoro editoria scolastica coordinatore didattico Torino dipendente
searches_run.observation: The small sample did not establish a current salaried educational-publishing match; results included institutional material, older coordination recruitment and broad education pages. Role translation is still needed.

sources.title: Offerte di lavoro — Lycée Français International Jean Giono
sources.supports: Directly inspected school page advertises 2025–2026 replacement roles, specific language/system experience and collaboration/fixed-term wording. It is not evidence of a current permanent job or this persona's eligibility.

sources.title: Insegnante — Istituto San Secondo on Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved snippet describes secondary-school science/technical support as an internship in Turin, illustrating title and experience mismatch.

sources.title: Selezione Coordinatore Pedagogico — Città di Torino
sources.supports: An older official selection document surfaced for coordination work; it is not treated as a currently open vacancy or credential advice.

best_entry_page.primary_query: lavori alternativi insegnante editoria scolastica Torino
best_entry_page.promise: Explore nearby education employers and the job titles they use, with concrete duties and employment terms where current postings exist.
best_entry_page.cta: Browse covered schools and education companies before deciding whether alerts would help.
proof_needed: Verify school and publisher coverage before investing in this niche landing.
Provide current employed-role examples, not stale school-year notices.
Explain adjacent titles without promising qualification equivalence.
Separate employment, internships and freelance collaboration using source terms.
Make clear that learning coordination and teaching are different roles.
New indexable Italian guide would be required.

conversion_objections: Do you cover local schools and publishers?
Will every result be private lessons or a training course?
Which titles actually use my classroom experience?
Is hybrid stated for this vacancy?
Does a school careers page contain a real opening for this school year?

avoid_targeting.query: abilitazione insegnante scuola privata requisiti legali
avoid_targeting.reason: Credentials and legal requirements are outside this research promise.
Course-purchase intent is not the desired employed-work outcome.

message_to_founder: Simulation: So progettare attività e materiali didattici, ma non so quali titoli cercare fuori dalla scuola. Fatemi vedere lavori da dipendente a Torino e mansioni concrete; non voglio arrivare su un altro corso da comprare.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic transition search. Two queries and one direct school-page inspection show retrieval ambiguity, not an established viable market for this niche. Current coverage, qualifications, experience in publishing and exact commute are unknown; conversion may be poor without relevant employers.

search_journey.fit_reason: Local education coverage must be proven.
Discovery fits if employers are covered.
Broad career counselling is outside core product.
